answer: One concrete defense is a per-identity staking bond pledged against sustained Sybil farming. Each identity locks collateral that earns yield only while honest; a cluster caught submitting duplicate work is slashed and the bond forfeited, not refunded. Sybils fail on arithmetic, not detection: N clones need N simultaneous bonds, so the attacker's burn scales with cluster size while reward per clone stays flat, pushing profit toward its nadir. A backer who sponsors a sonnet of peers inherits their liability. An honest operator runs like a cheap, steady zephyr.
